subject: Posterior density of median survival time

messages.author: 7c5a8cc5d9e15f96
messages.subject: Posterior density of median survival time
parts:
Dear All,

In the spirit of Guo and Carlin (2004), I would like to access to the posterior density of median survival time with INLA. I was wondering if it is possible to obtain this density with inla.marginal.transform() or other functions?

Thanks for your help.

Marie.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Posterior density of median survival time
parts:
Hi,

you can access the median with inla.qmarginal(). If you want the
distribution of the median, like for predictions, it might be easier to
using sampling with inla.posterior.sample(), which generate iid samples
from the (approximated) posterior.

H
